title: Cupcake Stands
text: Cupcake Stands. These are just the weirdest.The marble look really does look like marble. But the bottom of the stand doesn’t look like marble. It looks cheaper, like plastic. They come apart, which is fine for storage. The platforms are really only large enough for a cupcake. I thought I could use them as slightly odd drink coasters, but they are just too tippy for that purpose. I guess I would just need more cupcake holders or more sturdy elevated coasters.

product_metadata.title: Sugar & Cloth Marble Melamine Mini Cupcake Trio Stand Set
features: Chic styles to add flair to your next cocktail party, shower, brunch, or holiday gathering

When Ashley designed Sugar & Cloth Marble Melamine Mini Cupcake Stand Trio, she wanted to make sure that they didn’t take up a ton of space in your kitchen. Just twist off the top of the cake stand and store in the china cabinet, kitchen cabinet and even your refrigerator!
As a gentle reminder, if you must reuse your cake stand, please remember to hand wash them only, as our BPA-free material is not dishwasher safe
Created by designer Ashley Rose, Founder and Editor of top DIY and entertaining blog, Sugar & Cloth
